summary: Validated backend+frontend changes on public preview URL for avatar replacement, Binance connector conditional init, and onchain invalid-network validation. All targeted flows passed; backend regression suite now 36/36 passing after adding detail-endpoint invalid-network test.

integration_issues.issue: Build succeeds but emits large third-party source-map warnings including optional '@react-native-async-storage/async-storage' resolution warnings from wallet SDK dependency tree.

action_items: Optional: reduce noisy wallet/dependency source-map warnings during frontend build for cleaner CI logs.
Optional: avoid using broad data-testid prefixes like 'onchain-agent-*' for both container and item nodes to keep automation selectors unambiguous.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend network validation is now consistent for /api/onchain/agents/{token_id}; 400 response for invalid network verified.
Binance connector conditional initialization in wagmi.ts works as intended: no nbstream websocket console error observed when extension is absent.
Avatar rollout is deterministic/local SVG-based via AgentAvatar in marketplace, compare, detail, and onchain pages; no remote card image dependency observed in tested flows.
test_credentials: Checked /app/memory/test_credentials.md before auth-related testing; file exists but contains no credentials.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL tested: https://agent-marketplace-131.preview.emergentagent.com. Backend tests require REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL exported (set -a && source /app/frontend/.env). Pytest result: 36 passed. UI verified: marketplace avatars SVG/no initials/~42px, compare avatars present via data-testid, detail avatar SVG/~68px, wallet menu shows MetaMask + Binance install option when extension absent, onchain mainnet/testnet each render 100 avatar icons (no onchain card usage), and console logs contain no nbstream websocket or mixed-content/CORS image errors.
rca of the issue: Previous websocket error RCA confirmed resolved: Binance connector now only added when window.binancew3w.ethereum exists, preventing premature connector bootstrap socket attempts on users without extension.
